summary: Teaching vowel synth: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. A glottal pulse (round to buzzing, with a sub and drive) and breath noise through four formant band-pass filters that move across the vowels A, E, I, O and U, with the tract size, the formants' Q and a talking envelope that sweeps the vowel on every key, an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for choirs, talking basses, robot voices and whispers, or to learn how formants make vowels.
use_for: A teaching vowel synth: choirs, talking basses and whispers from four formant filters that move across A, E, I, O and U, with tract size, Q and a talking envelope.

parameters.name: Vowel (A-E-I-O-U)
parameters.description: Continuously interpolates the center frequencies of the four formant bandpass filters across A -> E -> I -> O -> U.
parameters.how: Continuously interpolates the center frequencies of the four formant bandpass filters across A -> E -> I -> O -> U.
parameters.sound: Makes the synth articulate distinct human vowel sounds as you turn the knob.

parameters.name: Tract Size
parameters.description: Shifts all four formant frequencies down or up in unison without changing the played musical pitch.
parameters.how: Shifts all four formant frequencies down or up in unison without changing the played musical pitch.
parameters.sound: Changes the perceived singer from a giant deep bass (-100%) to a baritone (0%) to a high soprano/child (+100%).

parameters.name: Formant Q
parameters.description: Controls the bandwidth (sharpness) of the four resonant vocal tract filter peaks.
parameters.how: Controls the bandwidth (sharpness) of the four resonant vocal tract filter peaks.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound like warm, natural choir pads; high values sound intensely nasal, robotic, and "talking."

parameters.name: Glottal / Bass
parameters.description: Shapes the excitation pulse sharpness and adds sub-glottal harmonic distortion before the formant bank.
parameters.how: Shapes the excitation pulse sharpness and adds sub-glottal harmonic distortion before the formant bank.
parameters.sound: At low values the voice is soft and choral; at high values it becomes an aggressive "talking" synth bass.

parameters.name: Breath Noise
parameters.description: Mixes aspirated noise into the vocal tract filters alongside the pitched pulse.
parameters.how: Mixes aspirated noise into the vocal tract filters alongside the pitched pulse.
parameters.sound: Adds whispery air, human breathiness, and wind-like choir textures.

parameters.name: Talking Env
parameters.description: Uses the note envelope to automatically sweep Vowel on every key press.
parameters.how: Uses the note envelope to automatically sweep Vowel on every key press.
parameters.sound: Makes each note articulate syllables like "Wah", "Yah", or "Yoi" automatically.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.
